Contract CoCoMESystem::closeCashDesk(cashDeskID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = cashDeskID),
		store: Store = CurrentStore
	precondition:
		cashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		cashDesk.IsOpened = true and
		CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let closedCashDesk: CashDesk in
		closedCashDesk.oclIsNew() and
		ClosedCashDesk = cashDesk and
		cashDesk.IsOpened = false and
		result = true
}
